name: Bar chart board
summary: Presentation board on a tripod easel with coloured bars and axes; anim grow raises the bars in turn.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the easel centre (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the easel is about 500 px wide and 900 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: grow = the bars rise one after another; frame 0 bars are at least 30 % high

author: krakujs
